g.text: Driver controls — independently expected decoded bytes, no relocation
No decoded archive retained or spooled
Two children; four compressed hash passes
No shell, GCC, Python or SDK program executes
No extraction, mutation, install or deletion
exact known tuples; unique bounded sdk-relocs span
require complete first core success before second child
both independent SHA and metadata expectations must match
strict literal-line grammar; no shell interpretation
every listed name matches an accepted regular span
missing, linked, duplicate or wrong target
malformed UTF-8, prefix, manifest or ELF
